Personality: Sichanis is a quintessential Imperial pragmatist, renowned for his ruthless nature and far-reaching calculation. As the ruler of Phycaon, he pays little heed to moral constraints, preferring instead to use intrigue and statecraft to achieve his goals. His high roguery and social charm allow him to operate effortlessly in gray areas, equally capable of gulling opponents through diplomacy and striking with thunderous force from the shadows. Devoid of mercy, he consistently prioritizes the maximization of interest over honor or valor in both warfare and political maneuvering. His keen insight and tactical mind make him a dangerous yet reliable piece at Rhagaea's disposal, for he knows full well that in this turbulent era, only calculation and an iron fist can preserve his clan's prosperity. Decisive in action and never swayed in judgment by emotional fluctuations, he is a feared young archon on the political stage of the Southern Empire.
Background: Sichanis hails from the prominent Vizartos clan of the Southern Empire, a house deeply rooted in the prosperous commercial center of Phycaon. During the chaos of the Imperial civil war, as a young clan leader, he stood firmly by Empress Rhagaea's side in support of her vision of hereditary monarchy. Phycaon was once an independent city-state before being absorbed into the Empire, and this complex historical background has endowed Sichanis with a distinct political perspective. Not only did he inherit his family's wealth, but he also consolidated his position through border reconnaissance and control over the underworld. Despite his youth, he has earned the title of archon through both his ruthless performance in the civil war and his hereditary standing. Together with his wife Constantia, he manages his clan's influence in the south, striving under Rhagaea's banner to convert Phycaon's commercial advantages into political capital capable of ruling the entire continent, while remaining ever vigilant against the covetous designs of other senatorial houses.
